## The regions are monitored as in the following scoping projects
### **Prod** - vsa-monitoring-prod - Project ###
### **Stage** - vsa-monitoring-stage - Project ###
### **Autopush** - vsa-monitoring-nonprod - Project ###


## The dashboards are organized using the following labels

## 1. **Executive** - A set of dashboards for service level overview 
## 2. **Leadership** - A set of dashboards for feature level or customer specific overview
## 3. **Engineering** - A set of dashboards for engineering teams to get into debugging at a component level
